messages.build.card.body.power:
Strengthens primary, heavy and wave attacks.
Derived hits are not amplified twice.
messages.build.card.body.agility:
Move faster between attacks.
Dodge speed is unchanged.
messages.build.card.body.wave:
Primary attacks launch a wave even on a miss.
It ends on contact with a target or wall.
messages.build.card.body.chain:
Hits jump to nearby foes.
Each jump retains {falloff_percent}% damage.
messages.build.card.body.split:
Projectiles split on enemy contact.
Children deal {damage_percent}% damage.
messages.build.card.body.impact_blast:
Contact creates a falling-off area blast.
The direct target is not hit twice.
messages.build.card.body.contact_slow:
Hits slow for {duration_sec} s.
Reapplying retains the longer time.
messages.build.card.body.contact_freeze:
Directly contacted foes freeze.
Thawing grants brief freeze resistance.
messages.build.card.body.freeze_duration:
Extends this action's freezes.
This action must already be able to freeze.
messages.build.card.body.pierce:
Linear waves pass through several foes.
Exclusive with Split on the same action.
messages.build.card.body.frost_blast:
Compatible blasts freeze nearby foes.
Requires Impact Blast.
messages.build.card.body.action_power:
Strengthens the bound action.
Combines with global damage bonuses.
messages.build.card.body.shatter_followup:
Punish a frost window from an earlier wave.
A wave cannot enable its own follow-up.
messages.build.card.body.opening_strike:
Primary punishes a frost window from another action.
Boosts direct hits without consuming freeze.
messages.build.card.body.returning_wave:
Waves return after reaching range or hitting.
The return can hit again; walls still block it.
messages.build.card.body.charged_wave:
Hold RMB for {threshold_sec} s, then release.
A charged wide crescent has ×{cooldown_ratio} cooldown.
messages.build.card.body.shatter_heavy:
Heavy attacks consume a prior frost window.
The stronger hit is followed by freeze resistance.
messages.build.card.body.frost_path:
Requires a wave capable of freezing.
Leaves a slowing trail; the trail never freezes.
messages.build.card.body.ice_coat:
Gain a shield when a wave creates a frost window.
Lasts {duration_sec} s; triggers every {trigger_cooldown_sec} s.
messages.build.card.body.fire_core:
Hits apply {stacks_per_hit} burn stack(s).
Burn deals damage over time.
messages.build.card.body.ice_core:
Hits apply {stacks_per_hit} chill stack(s).
Full stacks freeze, or strongly slow bosses.
messages.build.card.body.thunder_core:
Hits apply shock.
The next hit discharges into nearby foes.
messages.build.card.body.earth_core:
Hits apply {stacks_per_hit} fracture stack(s).
Foes take more damage and lose guard faster.
messages.build.card.body.fire_kindling:
Each burn stack deals more damage over time.
Embers keep hurting foes.
messages.build.card.body.fire_blaze:
Raises the burn stack limit.
Repeated hits build a stronger blaze.
messages.build.card.body.fire_linger:
Burn remains active longer.
Damage continues after you move away.
messages.build.card.body.ice_deep:
Fewer chill stacks are needed to freeze.
Create frost windows sooner.
messages.build.card.body.ice_lasting:
Chill lasts longer.
Keep the slow and build stacks more easily.
messages.build.card.body.ice_brittle:
Every chill stack adds vulnerability.
Press the attack while chill lasts.
messages.build.card.body.thunder_chain:
Discharge can reach more foes.
Useful against clustered enemies.
messages.build.card.body.thunder_surge:
Increases shock discharge damage.
The next hit triggers stronger arcs.
messages.build.card.body.thunder_reach:
Discharge arcs travel farther.
Connect enemies spread farther apart.
messages.build.card.body.earth_crush:
Every fracture stack adds vulnerability.
Exploit broken defenses.
messages.build.card.body.earth_quake:
Earth hits deal extra guard damage.
Break armored foes' guard sooner.
messages.build.card.body.earth_layers:
Raises the fracture stack limit.
Build additional vulnerability.
messages.build.card.body.dual_steam:
Requires both fire and ice.
Strengthens their steam reaction.
messages.build.card.body.dual_overload:
Requires both fire and lightning.
Overload also gains {radius_bonus_m} m radius.
messages.build.card.body.dual_lava:
Requires both fire and earth.
Lava also gains {radius_bonus_m} m radius.
messages.build.card.body.dual_superconduct:
Requires both ice and lightning.
Superconduct gains {radius_bonus_m} m radius.
messages.build.card.body.dual_shatter:
Freeze first, then strike with earth.
Shatter also gains {radius_bonus_m} m radius.
messages.build.card.body.dual_magnet:
Requires both lightning and earth.
Magnet pull gains {radius_bonus_m} m radius.
messages.build.card.body.fire_mastery_burst:
Requires fire on two actions.
Full burn stacks explode and spread burn.
messages.build.card.body.fire_mastery_heat:
Requires fire on two actions.
Further strengthens damage per burn stack.
messages.build.card.body.ice_mastery_burst:
Requires ice on two actions.
Freezing bursts into shards and spreads chill.
messages.build.card.body.ice_mastery_cold:
Requires ice on two actions.
Further strengthens chill vulnerability.
messages.build.card.body.thunder_mastery_burst:
Requires lightning on two actions.
Discharge spreads damage and shock.
messages.build.card.body.thunder_mastery_storm:
Requires lightning on two actions.
Further strengthens discharge damage.
messages.build.card.body.earth_mastery_burst:
Requires earth on two actions.
Full fracture stacks rupture and spread fracture.
messages.build.card.body.earth_mastery_weight:
Requires earth on two actions.
Further strengthens fracture vulnerability.
messages.build.card.body.primary_reach:
Extends the reach of primary attacks.
Keep your distance while striking.
messages.build.card.body.special_reach:
Extends the reach of heavy attacks.
A wider sweep covers more enemies.

messages.build.shatter_followup.name: Shatter Follow-up
messages.build.shatter_followup.description: RMB waves deal +{bonus_percent}% direct damage during a frost window (freeze or boss frost slow) from your earlier independent RMB cast. The same cast and its return cannot follow themselves. Does not consume or refresh freeze; split and blast damage are unaffected. Requires RMB freeze capability, such as ice attunement.
messages.build.opening_strike.name: Opening Strike
messages.build.opening_strike.description: LMB direct hits deal +{bonus_percent}% damage during a frost window (freeze or boss frost slow) established by your earlier independent cast of another formal action. LMB-created windows do not count. Does not consume freeze or boost blasts.
messages.build.reward.title: Reward source
messages.build.frost.returning_wave.name: Returning Wave
messages.build.frost.returning_wave.description: The wave returns after reaching its range or hitting an enemy. Walls stop it.
messages.build.frost.charged_wave.name: Charged Frost
messages.build.frost.charged_wave.description: Release RMB to fire. Hold {threshold_sec}s for a full-size frost crescent dealing {damage_percent}% normal damage with {cooldown_ratio}x cooldown; release earlier for a normal wave. Frost visuals alone do not grant freeze.
messages.build.frost.shatter_heavy.name: Shattering Heavy
messages.build.frost.shatter_heavy.description: Heavy strikes consume your earlier active frost window (hard freeze or boss slow) for bonus damage and start thaw immunity. Marks remain; once per cast.
messages.build.frost.frost_path.name: Frost Path
messages.build.frost.frost_path.description: Requires RMB freeze capability, such as ice attunement. Waves leave a trail lasting {lifetime_sec}s with radius {radius_m}m. The trail only slows; it cannot freeze. Split children do not create trails.
messages.build.frost.ice_coat.name: Ice Coat
messages.build.frost.ice_coat.description: Requires RMB freeze capability, such as ice attunement. Successfully opening a freeze or boss frost slow window with RMB grants {shield_amount} shield for {duration_sec}s, with a {trigger_cooldown_sec}s trigger cooldown. Chill buildup and resisted freeze attempts do not grant protection.
messages.build.mastery.fire_burst.name: Conflagration (Fire Mastery)
messages.build.mastery.fire_burst.description: Needs two Fire actions. Full Burn detonates: {damage} damage (+{damage_per_stack} per stack), hitting {max_targets} foes within {radius_m} m and applying {spread_stacks} Burn.
messages.build.mastery.fire_heat.name: Fire Resonance (Fire Mastery)
messages.build.mastery.fire_heat.description: Needs two Fire actions. Burn damage per stack per tick +{add}.
messages.build.mastery.ice_burst.name: Ice Burst (Ice Mastery)
messages.build.mastery.ice_burst.description: Needs two Ice actions. Freezing a foe bursts shards: {damage} damage (+{damage_per_stack} per stack) to {max_targets} foes within {radius_m} m, applying {spread_stacks} Chill.
messages.build.mastery.ice_cold.name: Deep Cold (Ice Mastery)
messages.build.mastery.ice_cold.description: Needs two Ice actions. Each Chill stack adds +{add_percent}% damage taken.
messages.build.mastery.thunder_burst.name: Thunder Surge (Thunder Mastery)
messages.build.mastery.thunder_burst.description: Needs two Thunder actions. Discharges arc to {max_targets} foes within {radius_m} m: {damage} damage and Shock, chaining onward.
messages.build.mastery.thunder_storm.name: Storm Resonance (Thunder Mastery)
messages.build.mastery.thunder_storm.description: Needs two Thunder actions. Discharge damage +{add}.
messages.build.mastery.earth_burst.name: Earthsplit (Earth Mastery)
messages.build.mastery.earth_burst.description: Needs two Earth actions. Full Sunder splits the ground: {damage} damage (+{damage_per_stack} per stack) to {max_targets} foes within {radius_m} m, applying {spread_stacks} Sunder.
messages.build.mastery.earth_weight.name: Mountain Resonance (Earth Mastery)
messages.build.mastery.earth_weight.description: Needs two Earth actions. Each Sunder stack adds +{add_percent}% damage taken.
